Question: I wanted the meaning of my dreams all these dreams were on different days plz tel me the tabir of these dreams. 1. I saw a snake which is eating himself from his tail, at last only this head remians with both the eyes coming out. 2. As my father stays abroad, I saw in dream that i have recived a call saying that my dad is died. 3. I Saw i am taking out water from a well. Answer ID: 22260 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 737/577/D=1431) (1) In-sha-Allah, your enemies will perish and suffer a reverse. (2) In-sha-Allah, your father will live long. (3) In-sha-Allah, there will be growth and prosperity in your wealth, so keep on spending in good deeds and doing kindness towards your relatives. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
